name: scene-vad
title: Vad
description: A banyan grows in pen and ink by space colonisation: branch tips reach for the nearest points of an umbrella canopy, limbs thicken by the pipe model, leaf masses are hatched over a green wash, and aerial roots drop and thicken into pillar trunks round a stone platform. Quiet is the grown tree; warm grows it slowly and lets the ink boil; playful grows a new one on Enter. Set progress and the tree grows exactly as far as the work has. With words="world", the page’s words are written in the sky beside the tree, each line ending where the canopy begins, and make room for it four times as it grows.
